name: mercadolibre.com.co
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.
lesson: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.
summary: www.mercadolibre.com.co scores 50 out of 100 (F). 9 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: 16 pages have no title.

fix.title: 16 pages have no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /, Perplexity-User (Perplexity, when a person asks it to…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 87 pages have no measurement tag while the start page does
fix.fix: Load the same tag from the shared layout on every page.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies _d2id on mercadoclics.com, _hjSessionUser_720735, _hjSession_720735.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 80 elements on /, for example a[aria-label="air fryer"] and a[aria-label="aire acondicionado"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 530 ms
Language alternates point at each other
